event_confirmation: Investing.com preview dated 2026-10-22 says Q2 FY27 results 'Thursday after market close'; creditinvesting substack dated 2026-10-21 says 'expected on 22 October'; Yahoo Finance preview dated 2026-10-20 says Thursday. No company call-announcement release was retrievable (ir.deckers.com renders as a shell). Session amc consistent with every prior DECK print in the baseline.
conviction_note: Evidence is two-sided and mostly proxy: sell-side channel checks (UBS, BMO), Google search trends, peer prints and a very-strong-El-Nino winter outlook point soft on HOKA US and the UGG H2 guide, while a doubled short base (8.7% of float), call-side skew (-10.4), cheap buybacks, an unbooked ~$120m IEEPA refund claim and a clean full-price/inventory position point the other way; findings net +0.5 and the scaled read is p_up 51 on an 11% absolute move (+0.22), the two agreeing that there is no strong edge.
bar: Q2 FY27 consensus revenue ~$1.51bn and EPS ~$1.79 (Investing.com 2026-10-22, https://za.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/deckers-earnings-up-next-can-hoka-sustain-growth-momentum-93CH-4520052); revenue cross-checks to Williams Trading's UGG +5.8% / HOKA +8.9% on the Q2 FY26 base of $1.431bn (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/could-deckers-second-quarter-earnings-203253670.html); EPS consensus is disputed between $1.77 (Zacks, via thestockobserver), $1.79 (Investing.com) and $1.82 (creditinvesting substack). Company frame: Q2 revenue up ~5% and Q2 EPS $1.73-1.78 per an automated summary of the Q1 call (https://gloom.sh/stocks/deck/transcripts/q1-2027), not confirmed in the release itself; FY27 guide $5.86-5.91bn revenue, EPS $7.35-7.50 (8-K 2026-07-23, https://sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052126000015/deckex991pressrelease-6302.htm). Revenue bar is sourced by two agreeing sources; EPS bar is disputed by ~3 cents, so EPS-dependent findings are capped small. The stock historically trades on the full-year guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 11,813,489 shares = 8.71% of float, 3.2 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-30 (published 2026-10-09), up 24.9% from 9,457,002 on 2026-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/DECK/short-interest/) and roughly double the ~5.8m shares at the 2026-07-15 settlement (curvedtrading via search snippet). Elevated and building but below the 18-23% crowded-squeeze cases. Baseline skew_25d = -10.44 vol points (calls bid over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 1.06, straddle implied move 9.79%, ATM spread 19% of mid. Stock 27.8% off its 52-week high, +11.0% over 20 sessions, ~11.6x forward EPS.

findings.finding: Short interest doubled into the print: 11.81m shares (8.71% of float, 3.2 days to cover) at the 2026-09-30 settlement, +24.9% in two weeks and ~2x the ~5.8m in mid-July, while the option market pays for calls over puts (25d skew -10.4) and the stock has already bounced 11% in 20 sessions; a print that is merely not bad meets a growing short base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior DECK print in the baseline carried a short base this size that I could source; the name's reactions are large both ways (-20.5, -19.9, +11.4, -15.2, +19.5, +4.0, -0.2), and the +19.5% on 2026-01-29 came off a depressed, sceptical setup.
findings.why_not_priced: The short count is public but the baseline does not carry it; the call skew shows part of the squeeze risk is priced. If the build were fully priced you would expect the 20-day run-up to have reversed the build (the Oct 15 settlement, not yet published, would show it) and skew near zero.
findings.independence: Baseline skew_25d -10.44 / 'upside paid' (sealed baseline) is a separate measurement pointing the same way.

findings.finding: Two sell-side channel checks say HOKA US demand softened in the September quarter: UBS (Jay Sole) says its proprietary data show HOKA and UGG trends softer than thought in recent months and HOKA US demand cooled vs Q1, with web-traffic data as a partial offset; BMO (Kelly Crago, Underperform, $70, initiated 2026-09-08) says HOKA US DTC may have turned negative in Q2. Against this, Q1 global HOKA DTC was +17% and management said on 2026-07-23 there was 'not a significant change' in DTC for Q2; HOKA international (double digits) and UGG (~50% of Q2 revenue) are the rest of the company.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: HOKA US deceleration drove the -15.2% on 2025-10-23 (FY guide below consensus) and the -19.9% on 2025-05-22; a HOKA beat with flat guide on 2026-07-23 drew -0.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: both notes are public and the stock sits 28% below its high. Not fully, because consensus revenue (~$1.51bn) still embeds HOKA +8.9% and UBS frames Q2 as in-line; if the checks were priced, consensus HOKA growth would have been cut toward mid-single digits.
findings.independence: UBS web-traffic offset and PT cut to $140 (https://finimize.com/content/ubs-sees-deckers-q2-as-a-sentiment-check-not-a-reset, undated, references Oct 22 print). Both analyst views reach me through the same Yahoo article, so they are filed as one finding.

findings.finding: Google Trends: HOKA's Clifton franchise is down 11% in US search on the year and HOKA's share of running-brand search has eased as On gained, while Bondi (+12%) and Speedgoat (+13%) are up; UGG's last US winter search peak indexed 41 against 59 two winters earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No DECK print has been tied to search data in a source I can cite.
findings.why_not_priced: Search trends are free and widely watched; mostly priced. Filed small because franchise-level mix (Clifton down, newer franchises up) is not in the wire copy, and the Clifton 11 launched in July 2026.
findings.independence: Proxy. Points the same way as the UBS/BMO checks above but is a different data source.

findings.finding: NOAA's official winter outlook (2026-10-16) forecasts a 'very strong El Nino' winter with above-average temperatures across the Midwest, Mississippi Valley and much of the East for Dec-Feb; UGG's DTC business is over 80% second-half weighted, so management may hedge the UGG H2 / FY guide, even though the CEO said on the Q1 call there were 'no cancellations to the order books'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The -15.2% on 2025-10-23 came on a cautious H2 outlook; warm-weather caution has historically hit boot sellers' fall prints (Shoe Carnival 2024 precedent in search results, not DECK-specific).
findings.why_not_priced: Jefferies (Blake Anderson) already flagged El Nino risk to UGG in the 2026-10-20 Yahoo preview, so partly priced. Not fully: the NOAA outlook landed after the company last spoke, and FY revenue guide was held unchanged in July before it.
findings.independence: Jefferies warning in https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/could-deckers-second-quarter-earnings-203253670.html (same article as finding 2). Macro-to-company transmission, unconfirmed by the company.

findings.finding: Peers that reported after DECK's July call point to a soft, promotional US athletic-footwear channel: DICK'S (2026-08-25) cut Foot Locker comps guide to -2% to 0% after -3.6% and called the market increasingly promotional; On Holding (2026-08-11) missed sales and cut FY cc growth to low-20s; Nike (2026-10-01) revenue -5% cc with Direct down while wholesale held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No cited DECK reaction to peer read-through.
findings.why_not_priced: All three prints are public and DECK fell after them; mostly priced. Filed small because DICK'S/Foot Locker is a direct HOKA wholesale counterparty and its promotional comment postdates DECK's 'full-price' framing.

findings.finding: Deckers guides its quarters conservatively and has beaten them: Q2 FY26 EPS was $1.82 against consensus $1.58 on a +9.1% revenue quarter, and Q1 FY27 EPS $0.94 beat $0.88; for Q2 FY27 management framed revenue ~+5% with wholesale shipments deliberately moved to H2, so the reported quarter clears a low bar unless HOKA US is worse than the checks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sells quarterly beats when the guide disappoints: Q2 FY26 beat by $0.24 and fell 15.2%; Q1 FY27 beat and raised EPS and moved -0.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: consensus EPS ($1.79-1.82) already sits at or above the reported top of the guide. Only the revenue side, where consensus ~$1.51bn sits just above a ~+5% guide, carries an unpriced cushion.
findings.independence: Q2 FY26 beat: https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/deck-q2-earnings-beat-estimate-hoka-ugg-posts-double-digit-growth ; Q1 FY27 beat: https://www.cnhinews.com/news/article_e5cfd6bc-5176-5e03-a169-052f3db72d7c.html

findings.finding: Deckers' 10-Q (filed 2026-07-30) says it paid ~$120m gross of IEEPA tariffs, began filing CAPE Phase 2 refund claims after June 30, and recognises nothing until realised or realisable (ASC 450 gain contingency); the FY27 guide 'does not assume the collection of refunds'. CBP guidance puts payment at 60-90 days from acceptance, so claims filed in July pay out from late September through October. Net of manufacturer cost-sharing and tax, that is plausibly $0.30-0.50 of GAAP EPS that could land in Q2 or lift the GAAP-only FY guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior DECK print carried a refund. Across this repo's 2026-09 resolved days, four refund names split by guide direction (two up, two down double digits).
findings.why_not_priced: No preview I found mentions the refund; consensus EPS (+0.26% in 60 days) has not moved for it. Deckers reports GAAP-only, so a recognised refund shows up in headline EPS and possibly the EPS guide. Sized as a one-off because the street will likely look through it.
findings.independence: CBP timing: https://www.thompsonhinesmartrade.com/2026/06/cbp-confirms-june-29-2026-ieepa-tariff-refund-process-phase-2-launch/ ; Genesco's Q2 (2026-09-03) GAAP EPS included tariff refunds: https://genesco.gcs-web.com/node/26601

findings.finding: The FY27 EPS guide assumes buybacks of ~80% of free cash flow; Q1's $338m was bought at an average $103.79, and the stock has since traded ~$77-90, so each dollar retires 15-25% more shares than in Q1. Analysts (Investing.com, Williams Trading) expect an EPS raise on buybacks while revenue is held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 raised EPS 5 cents with revenue held and moved -0.2%: the market did not pay for a buyback-driven raise.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely expected: previews call for an EPS raise on buybacks. Filed small for the size of the share-count effect at the lower price, which previews do not quantify.

findings.finding: Full-price health is intact: inventories at 2026-06-30 were $807.6m, -4.9% year on year against sales +5.7%, and in early October only ~5% of UGG product on Zappos was discounted.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Clean inventory did not protect the 2026-07-23 print (-0.2%).
findings.why_not_priced: The inventory figure is public and priced; the October Zappos snapshot is a fresh, low-visibility read on UGG pricing power into the season. Small.
findings.independence: Inventory: https://sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/910521/000091052126000015/deckex991pressrelease-6302.htm ; Zappos/GOAT snapshot dated 2026-10-06 also in https://creditinvesting.substack.com/p/deckers-brands-nyse-deck-moderation

findings.finding: Evercore ISI (Jesalyn Wong) kept In-Line and cut its target from $108 to $90 on 2026-10-16, near spot, adding to a run of target cuts into the print (UBS $161 to $140).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No cited reaction to target changes.
findings.why_not_priced: Wire copy, priced; filed because target cuts into a print mean the buy side expects a lower bar, which also cushions a miss.

findings.finding: 8-K 2026-08-31: Deckers amended its Citibank-led unsecured revolver to $500m maturing 2031, with lower commitment fees, for working capital and general purposes; nothing in it suggests a draw, a covenant problem or a ramp. A routine extension.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced and immaterial; filed so the panel sees the financing was checked and found routine.

baseline_tension: Upside-paid skew (-10.4), an 11% 20-day bounce and a doubling short base lean up, while the soft-HOKA checks and El Nino point down; the evidence is split and does not cut cleanly against the market's lean, so p_up stays at 51.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (documents beat inference; no wins from weather reasoning): El Nino guide finding -1.0 to -0.6, Google Trends proxy -0.5 to -0.3, peer read-through -0.5 to -0.4
Rule 7 (sign against the skew; check short interest first): sell-side-checks negative -1.2 to -1.0, since 25d skew is -10.4 (upside paid) and short interest is 8.7% and building
Rule 1 (beats get sold on this name; Q1 beat-and-raise moved -0.2%): reported-quarter beat finding +0.5 to +0.4
Rule 2 and 'what has worked' (a refund recognition policy matched to a disbursement window): tariff-refund finding left at +0.8 as a one_off, with the GAAP-guide path stated
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the revolver was checked as a routine extension, left at 0
Scaled measurement: p_up 49 to 51 because the negatives are proxies against the skew; abs_move_pct 11 unchanged
